yoga_exercises.name: Child's Pose (Balasana)
yoga_exercises.description: A gentle resting pose that calms the mind
steps: Kneel on the floor with your big toes touching
Spread your knees hip-width apart
Exhale and fold forward, resting your torso between your thighs
Rest your forehead on the floor
Extend your arms forward or alongside your body
Hold for 30 seconds to 3 minutes

yoga_exercises.name: Cat-Cow Pose (Marjaryasana-Bitilasana)
yoga_exercises.description: Gentle spinal movement that releases tension
steps: Start on your hands and knees
Inhale: arch your back, look up (Cow pose)
Exhale: round your spine, tuck chin (Cat pose)
Continue flowing between poses for 1-2 minutes
Focus on your breath matching the movement

yoga_exercises.name: Legs Up the Wall (Viparita Karani)
steps: Sit with your right side against a wall
Swing your legs up the wall as you lie back
Rest your arms alongside your body, palms up
Close your eyes and breathe deeply
Hold for 5-15 minutes

yoga_exercises.name: Corpse Pose (Savasana)
steps: Lie on your back with legs slightly apart
Let your arms rest alongside your body, palms up
Close your eyes and relax your entire body
Focus on your breath without trying to control it
Stay for 5-10 minutes
